About

Hi, I’m Raviraj Mehta

aka Bornunique911 — a cybersecurity enthusiast, CTF player, and open-source contributor interested in application security, vulnerability research, and practical security engineering.

I come from a non-tech background and have built my cybersecurity skills primarily through hands-on labs, CTFs, certifications, open-source work, and community learning.

📊 By the Numbers

   
🧩 500+ TryHackMe & Hack The Box rooms
🏁 150+ CTF competitions

✅ 10 OpenCRE PRs merged
📚 4+ Cybersecurity certifications & professional courses
💻 5+ Security platforms actively used

🧠 Cybersecurity Journey

My journey started with platforms such as TryHackMe and Hack The Box, where I solved through hundreds of rooms covering web application security, penetration testing, Linux, networking, privilege escalation, and other security concepts.

CTFs are a major part of how I learn. Solving challenges forces me to research unfamiliar technologies, think creatively, and turn theory into practical skills. I’ve participated in 150+ CTF competitions through CTFtime.org and continue to use them as a way to explore new areas of security.

🛠️ Open Source & OWASP

I contribute to OWASP OpenCRE, an open-source platform for connecting security requirements with standards and guidelines.

My 25 PRs (4 open PR’s, 21 closed PR’s including 10 PR’s merged) have included work on:

  • AI/LLM and Kubernetes resource importers Built resource importers and integrated parsing, mapping, CLI support, and tests for AI/LLM and Kubernetes resources. PR #960

  • CWE mapping, inheritance, and data cleanup Improved CWE mapping through inheritance and related-CWE handling, while cleaning and maintaining mapping data. PR #823 · PR #939 · PR #992

  • ETL pipelines, refresh tooling, and validation Worked on ETL workflows, refresh tooling, and validation to keep imported security data consistent and reliable. PR #950 · PR #952

  • Upstream synchronization and retry handling Improved synchronization with upstream sources and added retry handling for more reliable imports. PR #951

  • Testing, CLI tooling, documentation, and contributor workflows Added tests, improved CLI tooling and documentation, and streamlined contributor workflows. PR #997

This work has given me practical experience with Python, parsers, ETL/data pipelines, SQLite/SQLAlchemy, testing, CLI development, and security-standard mapping.

🎓 Certifications & Learning

I’ve completed the Google Cybersecurity Certificate, CompTIA Security+, IBM Cybersecurity Analyst Professional Certificate, and Google’s Bits and Bytes of Computer Networking, along with security-focused learning paths and CTF training from TryHackMe and Hack The Box.

I’m particularly interested in continuing to grow across web security, offensive security, vulnerability research, cloud/container security, and emerging technologies.
